GRADE 3 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Time: 32 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Time at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Time using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Time completely.
   C. Time is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

2. About Time using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Time at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Time completely.
   C. Time is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

3. About Time when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Time helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Time completely.
   C. Time is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Time.

5. About Money at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Money using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Money completely.
   C. Money is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Money.

6. About Money using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Money at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Money completely.
   C. Money is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Money.

7. About Money when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Money helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Money completely.
   C. Money is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Money.

9. About Position and Direction at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. turn to the right from a point, turn to the right or left.
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Direction completely.
   C. Position and Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Direction.

10. About Position and Direction using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. turn to the right from a point, turn to the right or left.
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Direction completely.
   C. Position and Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Direction.

11. About Position and Direction when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. turn to the right from a point, turn to the right or left.
   B. Learners should ignore Position and Direction completely.
   C. Position and Direction is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Position and Direction.

13. About Shapes at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Shapes using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Shapes completely.
   C. Shapes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Shapes.

14. About Shapes using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Shapes at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Shapes completely.
   C. Shapes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Shapes.

15. About Shapes when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Shapes helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Shapes completely.
   C. Shapes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Shapes.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Time at the market in your county.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Money at the market in your county.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Position and Direction at the market in your county.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Shapes at the market in your county.
